title: Emberdeep launcher icon
mode: New original image; no reference images

A sculpted bright cyan water curl wraps around and quenches one warm orange flame; a simple forest pine silhouette is integrated in the central negative space. Deep dark forest green background fills the full square. Clean chunky shapes, slight polished toy-like dimensional shading, crisp silhouette, strong orange/cyan contrast. All essential artwork stays inside the central 60 percent of the image, with generous dark background around it for Android circular and rounded-square adaptive masking. Exactly one finished icon, not a sheet of variants.
